runtime: Closed enabled TS/JS runtime with canonical values; no optional scalars or external ABI.

representations.Char: Exactly one Unicode scalar encoded as well-formed UTF-16.
representations.String: Well-formed UTF-16 encoding a sequence of Unicode scalars; no normalization.
representations.Array: Dense array of canonical element values; no observable pointer identity.

positions.raw: Nonnegative UTF-8 byte offsets; raw get/next/extract keep their pinned total fallback behavior.
positions.source: UTF-8 byteOffset; one-based scalar columns/lines; CRLF consumes two bytes and one newline; initial BOM consumes three bytes without advancing column.

proofBoundary.arrayGetAndSet: Source requires a checked i<size proof. Erasure discards that proof; defensive runtime refusal is not a reconstruction or preservation proof.
proofBoundary.faultRepresentation: Thrown non-value object with the exact code field. No Error/RangeError global name is captured.
proofBoundary.hostProbeScope: Host callbacks test single evaluation/order with canonical inputs; they are not admitted source or a new FFI capability.

resources.carrier: maxNodes bounds model occurrences and each string's UTF-16 validation length separately; string length refusal precedes scanning.
resources.portable: Existing per-string UTF-8 byte, node and type-work budgets remain independent.
resources.allocation: Reference allocation hints are bounded (0 and 17). Value correspondence is conditional on successful allocation; native and JS capacity handling, allocation exhaustion, memory use and resource behavior are not claimed identical or total.

operations.law: Interpret the same nonnegative bigint as Int.
Conjunction; source demand short-circuits when first operand is false.
Disjunction; source demand short-circuits when first operand is true.
Scalar n when n<0xd800 or 0xdfff<n<0x110000; otherwise NUL.
Unicode scalar count, not UTF-16 units or graphemes.
At a scalar start before end: p+width; otherwise p+1.
At a scalar start before end: scalar; otherwise 'A'.

If start>=stop or start is not a scalar start before end, empty; otherwise copy until the matching stop boundary or end. Mid-byte behavior is pinned to Lean4.34 reference/runtime, not promised across versions.

sourceNames: Eq String in supported condition erasure

operations.law: Conditional on successful allocation, return an empty array; the capacity hint is evaluated once but is absent from observable array values. Native and JS allocation/resource behavior is not claimed identical.
